_about: Draft standard parameter names (night 0, track C). A later step maps each device profile's parameters onto these ids. midi_cc is given only where the MIDI 1.0 spec, RP-021 or GM 2 sound-controller defaults (CC70-79) assign one. Names were chosen from a frequency count of parameter names across midi.guide's 457 device files (commit 215c64e8), plus the MIDI-standard controllers.

parameters.name: Mod wheel
parameters.definition: The modulation wheel; its destination is set on the device.

parameters.name: Breath
parameters.definition: A breath controller's pressure.

parameters.name: Foot controller
parameters.definition: A continuous foot pedal.

parameters.name: Expression
parameters.definition: A volume scaling within the channel volume, usually a pedal.

parameters.name: Sustain pedal
parameters.definition: Holds released notes until the pedal lifts (damper).

parameters.name: Sostenuto
parameters.definition: Holds only the notes down when the pedal went down.

parameters.name: Soft pedal
parameters.definition: Softens notes played while it is down.

parameters.name: Legato footswitch
parameters.definition: Plays notes legato while it is down.

parameters.name: Pitch bend range
parameters.definition: How far the pitch wheel bends, in semitones (RPN 0).

parameters.name: Aftertouch amount
parameters.definition: How much key pressure modulates its destination.

parameters.name: Velocity sensitivity
parameters.definition: How much note velocity changes level or tone.

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.definition: The channel or part volume.

parameters.name: Pan
parameters.definition: Stereo position, left to right.

parameters.name: Balance
parameters.definition: Left/right balance of a stereo source.

parameters.name: Bank select MSB
parameters.definition: The coarse bank number for the next program change.

parameters.name: Bank select LSB
parameters.definition: The fine bank number for the next program change.

parameters.name: Data entry
parameters.definition: Sets the value of the selected RPN or NRPN.

parameters.name: All sound off
parameters.definition: Silences the channel at once, releases included.

parameters.name: Reset all controllers
parameters.definition: Returns the channel's controllers to their defaults.

parameters.name: Local control
parameters.definition: Connects or disconnects the device's own keys from its sound.

parameters.name: All notes off
parameters.definition: Releases every note on the channel.

parameters.name: Mono/poly mode
parameters.definition: Mono or poly reception (CC126 / CC127).

parameters.name: Master volume
parameters.definition: The device's overall output level.

parameters.name: Master tune
parameters.definition: Fine tuning of the whole device.

parameters.name: Transpose
parameters.definition: Shifts all notes by semitones.

parameters.name: Octave
parameters.definition: Shifts the keyboard or a part by octaves.

parameters.name: Tempo
parameters.definition: The internal clock's tempo, in BPM.

parameters.name: Swing
parameters.definition: Delays every other step for a shuffled feel.

parameters.name: Tap tempo
parameters.definition: Sets the tempo from taps.

parameters.name: Bypass
parameters.definition: Passes the input through unprocessed.

parameters.name: Oscillator waveform
parameters.definition: The oscillator's wave shape or wave selection.

parameters.name: Oscillator shape
parameters.definition: Continuous morph of the waveform (wave, timbre, shape).

parameters.name: Oscillator pitch
parameters.definition: The oscillator's coarse pitch, in semitones or octaves.

parameters.name: Oscillator fine tune
parameters.definition: The oscillator's fine pitch, in cents.

parameters.name: Oscillator level
parameters.definition: The oscillator's level into the mixer.

parameters.name: Pulse width
parameters.definition: The duty cycle of a pulse or square wave.

parameters.name: PWM amount
parameters.definition: How much a modulator varies the pulse width.

parameters.name: Oscillator sync
parameters.definition: Hard-syncs one oscillator to another.

parameters.name: FM amount
parameters.definition: Frequency modulation depth between oscillators or operators.

parameters.name: Ring modulation
parameters.definition: The level of the ring-modulated product of two oscillators.

parameters.name: Sub oscillator level
parameters.definition: The level of an oscillator an octave or two below.

parameters.name: Noise level
parameters.definition: The level of the noise source.

parameters.name: Oscillator mix
parameters.definition: The balance between two oscillators.

parameters.name: Detune
parameters.definition: Pitch spread between oscillators or voices.

parameters.name: Engine type
parameters.definition: Selects the synthesis engine or oscillator model.

parameters.name: Wavetable position
parameters.definition: The position within a wavetable.

parameters.name: Filter cutoff
parameters.definition: The filter's cutoff frequency (brightness).

parameters.name: Filter resonance
parameters.definition: Emphasis at the cutoff frequency (Q).

parameters.name: Filter type
parameters.definition: Low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, and so on, or the filter model.

parameters.name: Filter slope
parameters.definition: The filter's steepness, in dB per octave or poles.

parameters.name: Filter drive
parameters.definition: Overdrive into the filter.

parameters.name: Filter envelope amount
parameters.definition: How much the filter envelope moves the cutoff.

parameters.name: Filter key tracking
parameters.definition: How much the cutoff follows the played note.

parameters.name: Filter velocity
parameters.definition: How much velocity moves the cutoff.

parameters.name: Filter LFO amount
parameters.definition: How much an LFO moves the cutoff.

parameters.name: High-pass cutoff
parameters.definition: A separate high-pass filter's cutoff.

parameters.name: Amp attack
parameters.definition: Time for the level to rise to full after a note starts.

parameters.name: Amp decay
parameters.definition: Time for the level to fall from full to the sustain level.

parameters.name: Amp sustain
parameters.definition: The level held while the note is held.

parameters.name: Amp release
parameters.definition: Time for the level to fade after the note ends.

parameters.name: Amp envelope amount
parameters.definition: How much the envelope shapes the level (vs. a gate).

parameters.name: Amp velocity
parameters.definition: How much velocity sets the level.

parameters.name: Filter envelope attack
parameters.definition: The filter envelope's attack time.

parameters.name: Filter envelope decay
parameters.definition: The filter envelope's decay time.

parameters.name: Filter envelope sustain
parameters.definition: The filter envelope's sustain level.

parameters.name: Filter envelope release
parameters.definition: The filter envelope's release time.

parameters.name: Mod envelope attack
parameters.definition: Attack time of an assignable envelope.

parameters.name: Mod envelope decay
parameters.definition: Decay time of an assignable envelope.

parameters.name: Mod envelope sustain
parameters.definition: Sustain level of an assignable envelope.

parameters.name: Mod envelope release
parameters.definition: Release time of an assignable envelope.

parameters.name: Mod envelope amount
parameters.definition: Depth of an assignable envelope at its destination.

parameters.name: LFO rate
parameters.definition: The LFO's speed, free or synced.

parameters.name: LFO shape
parameters.definition: The LFO's waveform.

parameters.name: LFO depth
parameters.definition: How much the LFO moves its destination.

parameters.name: LFO destination
parameters.definition: What the LFO modulates.

parameters.name: LFO sync
parameters.definition: Locks the LFO to the tempo.

parameters.name: LFO delay
parameters.definition: Time before the LFO fades in after a note.

parameters.name: LFO key trigger
parameters.definition: Restarts the LFO with each note.

parameters.name: Vibrato rate
parameters.definition: The pitch vibrato's speed.

parameters.name: Vibrato depth
parameters.definition: The pitch vibrato's depth.

parameters.name: Vibrato delay
parameters.definition: Time before vibrato starts.

parameters.name: Glide time
parameters.definition: Portamento time between notes.

parameters.name: Glide on/off
parameters.definition: Turns portamento on or off.

parameters.name: Glide mode
parameters.definition: When glide applies (always, legato, fixed rate or time).

parameters.name: Voice mode
parameters.definition: Poly, mono, unison, paraphonic, and so on.

parameters.name: Unison voices
parameters.definition: How many voices stack per note.

parameters.name: Unison detune
parameters.definition: Pitch spread of stacked unison voices.

parameters.name: Stereo spread
parameters.definition: How widely voices pan across the stereo field.

parameters.name: Legato
parameters.definition: Mono notes played overlapping do not retrigger envelopes.

parameters.name: Note priority
parameters.definition: Which held note a mono voice plays (last, low, high).

parameters.name: Polyphony
parameters.definition: The number of voices available.

parameters.name: Reverb send
parameters.definition: How much signal goes to the reverb.

parameters.name: Reverb time
parameters.definition: The reverb's decay length or size.

parameters.name: Reverb type
parameters.definition: The reverb's algorithm.

parameters.name: Chorus send
parameters.definition: How much signal goes to the chorus.

parameters.name: Chorus rate
parameters.definition: The chorus's modulation speed.

parameters.name: Chorus depth
parameters.definition: The chorus's modulation depth.

parameters.name: Delay send
parameters.definition: How much signal goes to the delay (CC94 on Felucca; not a MIDI standard).

parameters.name: Delay time
parameters.definition: The delay's time, free or synced.

parameters.name: Delay feedback
parameters.definition: How much of the delay's output repeats.

parameters.name: Effect mix
parameters.definition: The wet/dry balance of an effect.

parameters.name: Distortion
parameters.definition: Drive, overdrive or bit-crush amount.

parameters.name: Effect type
parameters.definition: Selects the effect algorithm.

parameters.name: EQ low
parameters.definition: Bass shelf gain.

parameters.name: EQ mid
parameters.definition: Mid band gain.

parameters.name: EQ high
parameters.definition: Treble shelf gain.

parameters.name: Arpeggiator on/off
parameters.definition: Turns the arpeggiator on or off.

parameters.name: Arpeggiator mode
parameters.definition: The note order: up, down, up/down, random, and so on.

parameters.name: Arpeggiator range
parameters.definition: How many octaves the arpeggio spans.

parameters.name: Arpeggiator rate
parameters.definition: The arpeggio's step length against the tempo.

parameters.name: Arpeggiator gate
parameters.definition: Each arpeggio note's length.

parameters.name: Latch
parameters.definition: Keeps the arpeggio or chord playing after keys lift.

parameters.name: Play/stop
parameters.definition: Starts or stops the sequencer.

parameters.name: Sequence length
parameters.definition: The number of steps in a pattern.

parameters.name: Track mute
parameters.definition: Silences a track or part.

parameters.name: Track level
parameters.definition: A track or part's level within the device.
